title: observability: token-level logging, metrics & tracing dashboards + alert tuning
author: Ariana Patel
release_notes: Add token-level cost and latency metrics and new Grafana dashboards; tighten alert thresholds for token-latency regression and KV cache misses; update logging schema for trace correlation; rollout by feature flag. Impacts observability only, no API changes.
description: Motivation: engineers need finer-grained visibility into per-token cost and latency, and better trace/log correlation to diagnose tail latency tied to KV cache misses. This PR instruments token-level metrics across the runtime path, adds a set of Grafana dashboards for token-level cost/latency/KV metrics, updates logging to include trace_id/token_batch_id, and tunes alerting rules to reduce noise while surfacing real regressions. Summary of changes: 1) instrumentation: add token_level.response_latency_ms, token_level.token_cost_units, token_level.kv_cache_hit (counter/gauge/histogram as appropriate), and expose them in the metrics exporter; 2) tracing/logs: include token_batch_id and kv_cache_status in span tags and structured logs to link traces to token-level metrics; 3) dashboards: new Grafana dashboard JSON for token-cost/latency breakdown, per-model and per-route views, and a KV cache heatmap; 4) alerts: tuned alerting rules for token latency P95/P99 per-model, KV cache miss rate spike detector, and added a composite alert that suppresses paging for known noisy transient conditions; 5) feature flags: rollout gated behind observability.token_level_metrics flag with a staged rollout plan; 6) docs: updated observability runbook and dashboard walkthrough. Testing and rollout: unit tests for metrics formatting and trace propagation, integration tests validating metrics emitted for synthetic workloads, manual dashboard QA on staging with representative traffic, and a canary rollout to 10% of production for 24h before full release. Backwards compatibility: metrics are additive and opt-in via feature flag, logging additions are additive fields compatible with current parsers. Rollback: feature flag toggle and alert threshold reversion. See linked Linear tickets for e2e checklist and rollout steps.
